scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.generate: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run generate
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run deploy
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tailor-platform/sdk --filter example run generate && pnpm run format && pnpm run "/^check:/"
scripts.check:lint: pnpm -r run lint:fix && pnpm run lint:vitest
scripts.lint: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run lint && pnpm run lint:vitest
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run lint:fix && pnpm run lint:vitest:fix
scripts.knip: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run knip
scripts.publint: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run publint
scripts.typecheck:go: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @tailor-platform/sdk --filter example run generate && pnpm -r run typecheck:go
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate && pnpm -r run typecheck
